welcome us.

scenes.name: Could stay forever, then wandering to the house

lines.text: I know my soul and
it could stay here forever,
leaving behind crosshairs for continuums and strains for serendipity.
A city born in unison out of the purest of fictions welcoming
me and welcoming all.
